patterns.note: Full-bleed, distinct vertical sections with varying background colors (video, pink, dark, dark blue, yellow) create strong visual breaks and thematic shifts, resembling pages in a digital book.
A highly expressive, handwritten-style display font is used for prominent headings, contrasting with a clean, legible sans-serif for body text and smaller labels.
A vibrant, almost neon yellow is used as a primary accent color for display text, set against a palette of soft pinks, deep blacks, and dark blues.
Sections reveal with a subtle fade-up or slide-in animation as they scroll into view, creating a dynamic reading experience. The initial hero features a looping video background.
Each major content block is presented as a full-width, full-height (or near full-height) section with a unique background and thematic content, reinforcing the 'digital book' feel.

technique_notes: The hero section uses a full-bleed looping video background with a large, custom-drawn text overlay that remains fixed or subtly scales as the user scrolls, eventually revealing the next section. A sticky header with branding and navigation persists at the top. Content sections below the hero are revealed using scroll-triggered animations (likely AOS), where elements fade in and slide slightly upwards as they enter the viewport, creating a staggered reveal effect.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, expressive handwritten display headings (~4-5x body text) with a clean, balanced sans-serif for body and subheadings.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp, with minimal rounding on interactive elements like input fields and buttons.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy, with generous vertical padding between full-width sections and comfortable line spacing within text blocks.

standout: The site's most distinctive feature is its bold and playful use of a custom, handwritten-style display font for primary headings, especially overlaid on the hero video. This, combined with the full-bleed, thematically distinct sections, creates an immersive, almost storybook-like experience that strongly reflects an artist's personal brand.
